title: Interrupted installation safely reconciles on rerun
journey: Exercise acquisition, payload mutation, platform integration and verification interruption; distinguish known pre-mutation failure, partial mutation and OutcomeUnknown; inspect authoritative state before continuing.

qualified_versions: Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 (P018 qualified; P020 native acceptance evidence pending)
Fedora 42 x86_64 (P018 qualified; P020 native acceptance evidence pending)
platform.desktop_session: required for graphical desktop journeys; otherwise not applicable

preconditions: Disposable dedicated acceptance identity and scenario-owned state.
No prior Synveil installation, package registration, installer-owned integration or stale acceptance state unless a declared upgrade/recovery source is required.
A brand-new OS and removal of unrelated user files are not required.
Use a disposable VM or explicitly scenario-owned acceptance machine; power/process interruption tests must never target a normal user or production host.

steps.description: Interrupt at a named safe test boundary in a disposable environment.
Rerun and reconcile authoritative state before retry.

assertions.description: Acquisition, payload mutation, platform integration and verification interruption points are reconciled against authoritative state before retry.
Recovered install reports success only after the normal verification boundary.

forbidden_outcomes.description: Installer lifecycle deletes user library content.
Credential value is written to ordinary config or diagnostics.
Unknown or newer schema is reset or downgraded.
Persistent startup is enabled without explicit user consent.
Desktop control is exposed through a public TCP/HTTP listener.
An ambiguous mutation is blindly replayed without authoritative reconciliation.
Installation is reported complete before payload, integration and launch verification.
